rawContent: @johniadarola Livestock farming produces more greenhouse gases than the transportation industry by far. A small lifestyle change, just one meatless day a week, by every person could make a huge impact. #MeatlessMonday #ClimateChange

@MisandryRocks @johniadarola While radical change would be ideal, sitting/ waiting for someone else to come up with solutions before we start is not an option. Skip the meat one day a week is something everyone is capable of and is an action that can start helping right now. #MeatlessMonday #climatechange
